cases.case_label: SVA in APC exon 12 (familial adenomatous polyposis)
cases.mechanism_detail: WGS coverage profile showed an SVA inserted into APC coding exon 12, disrupting the gene and predicted to cause premature termination of translation (loss of function); validated by PCR, no RNA study.
cases.quote: Upon further examination, however, we detected a coverage profile consistent with the insertion of SVA (SINE-R/VNTR/Alu) element in exon 12 (NM_000038) of the APC gene, predicted to lead to the loss of function of the genes protein product.
